subtitle: Smooth Stream
- Second Screen over UDP
- HEVC up to 120 Hz
- Smooth Frame Pacing
- In-app Updates
---
**A faster, steadier second screen**, updates that install from inside the app, and a phone keyboard that types every key once.

### Second screen
The new stream is the work of @Scrimas: [#4](https://github.com/P3DROVFX/ii-tools/pull/4) in the app and [P3DROVFX/ii-p3drovfx#181](https://github.com/P3DROVFX/ii-p3drovfx/pull/181) in the shell.

- **Video over UDP:** on Wi-Fi the picture travels as encrypted datagrams on the link's own port, with Reed–Solomon parity sized to the loss the phone measures. A lost packet costs at most its frame instead of freezing every frame behind it, and the PC falls back to the WebSocket by itself.
- **HEVC by default** where the phone decodes it (H.264 otherwise, switchable in the stream settings), on the phone's low-latency decoder, at the panel's top refresh rate (120 fps on a 120 Hz phone).
- **Frame pacing:** *Lowest latency* shows each frame the moment it is decoded; *Smooth* holds frames a steady delay after their capture, so Wi-Fi jitter doesn't show as uneven motion.
- **Latency you can see:** the stream panel shows the time from the PC's capture to the phone, split into PC · network · phone, with the frame rate.
- **No more smears:** a dropped frame now waits for the next key frame instead of drawing over broken references.
- **On the LAN when you're home:** a link made over Tailscale streams over the local network whenever the PC answers there.

### App
- **In-app updates:** a new release downloads inside the app, is checked against its size and SHA-256, and opens the system installer.
- **Keyboard on the PC:** the touchpad's and the second screen's keyboard no longer drop or repeat characters, and a swipe on the space bar moves the PC's cursor.

**Needs the latest [ii-p3drovfx](https://github.com/P3DROVFX/ii-p3drovfx) shell (`dev` branch)** for UDP video, HEVC and capture timing. For the best stream, install the shell's patched recorder: `scripts/wf-recorder-ii/build.sh install`. Older shells still work, over the WebSocket in H.264.

### Contributors
- @Scrimas: the second screen over UDP with parity, HEVC, frame pacing, capture timing and the patched recorder ([#4](https://github.com/P3DROVFX/ii-tools/pull/4), [ii-p3drovfx#181](https://github.com/P3DROVFX/ii-p3drovfx/pull/181)).
